summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency pulls install-time code from arbitrary host
details: package.json at line 12 declares the dependency `marker-index-symbol-schema` with its source set to the bare URL `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/marker-index-symbol-schema` instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that host serves, with no version pin and no integrity check, and runs any lifecycle scripts in the fetched tarball; the shipped `index.js` is a one-line stub that re-exports the fetched module, so `require()` of this package also loads code from that URL. The host `artifacts.creditslib.com` is unrelated to the declared `@flexmr` publisher, and the dependency name combined with the `@flexmr` scope has the shape of a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal package. The manifest is the entire payload: installing this package resolves and executes code controlled by whoever operates that host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
